Othello.name: Othello
Othello.summary: Othello is a conversion of the board game. It was developed by Kawada and published by HAL Laboratory for the Famicom Disk System in Japan.

Purikura Pocket 3 - Talent Debut Daisaku.name: Purikura Pocket 3: Talent Debut Daisakusen
Purikura Pocket 3 - Talent Debut Daisaku.summary: A variety game released in 1998. Participants aim to become television personalities within a year by completing "lessons" in the form of mini-games.

V-Rally - Championship Edition.name: V-Rally: Championship Edition
V-Rally - Championship Edition.summary: Game Boy port of V-Rally: Championship Edition.
